Cosmere.System.Roshar.Def.SurgebindingAb.label: Bloom
Cosmere.System.Roshar.Def.SurgebindingAb.description: Let the Surge of Progression radiate outward from your body. The ground responds immediately. Grass pushes up through bare earth. Vines creep along walls. Flowers open as if greeting a sudden spring. At higher Ideals, the energy is strong enough to seep into the people around you, encouraging their bodies to mend.
